title: HTTP/3 RFC 9114 Dynamic QPACK Stream-State Work Item
summary: Complete the local HTTP/3 integration seam that consumes peer QPACK encoder-stream instructions for dynamic request and response field sections.
planned_changes:
- Add client connection-level QPACK decoder state for response HEADERS.
- Feed peer QPACK encoder-stream bytes into the client decoder instead of treating the stream as diagnostics-only.
- Keep the existing server dynamic request decoder path intact and cover both directions with focused loopback tests.
- Add a negative response test for peers that require blocked dynamic response decoding without advertised blocked-stream credit.
- Update the QPACK stream-state gap ledger and generated SpecTrace triage.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 dynamic QPACK client/server tests, Release build of the affected test project, SpecTrace core validation, generated QUIC triage, and diff hygiene before committing.
out_of_scope: QPACK decoder-stream acknowledgments as a live HTTP/3 optimization.
completion_notes: The client now routes peer QPACK encoder-stream bytes into connection-level response header decoding, and focused loopback coverage proves dynamic response unblock behavior plus rejection when a peer exceeds the client's blocked-stream credit. Existing server loopback coverage continues to prove dynamic request decoding through the peer encoder stream.
